title: Statistics, Analytics Chart by @sajon_co: We wanted to solve one problem: why does tracking your money feel hard
notes:
We wanted to solve one problem: why does tracking your money feel harder than earning it? This dashboard redesign breaks everything down into actionable sections - savings trends, upcoming bills, contributions toward goals, and overall wealth distribution. No clutter, no friction. Just transparency and control. Design can make financial literacy feel effortless - this is a step in that direction.

Designer: @sajon_co. Curated on Collect UI (https://collectui.com).
